sentences.text: The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable u/s 376 of the IPC and section 4 of POCSO Act, 2012.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: The allegation against the petitioner is that he committed rape upon the daughter of informant on two occasions.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and has committed no offence.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: He has been falsely implicated in this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text:
It is submitted that the alleged occurrence is said to have taken place on 04.07.2020 and 25.11.2020 but the complaint case has been filed on 21.08.2021 i.e.
after delay of one year without giving any Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.45192 of 2022(3)
dt.20-02-2023 plausible explanation, which itself creates doubt about the prosecution case.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is further submitted that earlier the father of victim has fired upon this petitioner, who lodged a case bearing Vibhutipur P.S. Case No.184/2020 against the husband of the present informant and for the alleged offence, he was sent to the jail.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Thereafter, after coming from the jail, this concocted case has been lodged to implicate the petitioner by the husband of the informant.
sentences._hearing_file: Navin Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
